route to measured intervention implementation if design is complete

one follow-up bounded intervention implementation manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1533 designs interventions only; self-ID evidence requires measured wrong-history or donor-response degradation later.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If measured interventions are null, record that as evidence about the current source/pair set and audit before retargeting.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded intervention design can test whether M1531 accepted measured pairs exhibit wrong-history or donor-response sensitivity without materializing candidates.
success_criteria: design defines anchor replay donor selection variants metrics artifacts and guardrails
design keeps intervention run candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and corpus export blocked
design routes to one bounded intervention implementation or records a blocker
failure_criteria: design lacks wrong-history or donor-response intervention details
design routes directly to materialization training or private holdout
decision_rule: M1533 passes if it designs bounded measured history interventions while preserving no-materialization and no-training guardrails.
